note: The agent team's queue (docs/TEAM_PROTOCOL.md). Until the Onay Merkezi exists, the owner approves by setting a task's state to "approved" here.

tasks.title: Onay Merkezi: döngü raporu ve onay bekleyenler Kokpit'te; kabukta Onayla/Reddet, sesle "fikri onayla / yayını onayla"
tasks.roadmap_row: How it is built from here
tasks.goal: The cycle report and every task at an owner gate are readable in the Cockpit's Onay Merkezi; the owner approves or rejects in the shell or by voice; the decision is written where the next cycle reads it (team/queue.json state), never applied mid-run.
tasks.acceptance: A task at awaiting_owner / awaiting_release is listed with its proposal or report; Onayla moves it to approved and Reddet to stopped with the owner's reason; a voice approval is refused unless it names which gate (fikir / yayın) and resolves to exactly one task; a release approval never starts a release by itself; every decision is a ledger event.
tasks.evidence_expected: PROVEN_AUTOMATED for the API and the router; READY_FOR_OWNER for the shell and the voice path
